title: seer.ai
tagline: NFT trading application powered by AI agents to help people get into the world of NFT investin!g
description:
Our project harnesses **AI agents** powered by **Elisa OS** and **CDP AgentKit** to deliver comprehensive **NFT analytics** with a focus on **trading profitability** for creators, collectors, and marketplaces. The platform aggregates and analyzes real-time data from multiple blockchains to provide insights into **market trends**, **ownership history**, and **price fluctuations**. By using predictive modeling and AI-driven anomaly detection, it identifies patterns such as wash trading, price manipulation, and emerging trends, helping users optimize their trading strategies. The **profitability analysis** feature tracks individual NFT performance, calculates returns on investment, and suggests optimal buying/selling windows to maximize gains.

Leveraging **Elisa OS** for seamless agent orchestration and **CDP AgentKit** for advanced data processing, the platform delivers **personalized insights** tailored to user behavior and portfolio dynamics. The AI agents analyze historical trading data to forecast future market movements and identify **undervalued NFTs** with high profit potential. Customizable dashboards display profitability metrics, portfolio growth, and risk assessments, enabling users to make data-driven decisions. This innovative solution transforms raw blockchain data into actionable intelligence, helping users not just track, but strategically enhance their **NFT trading profitability** in a rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem.
how_its_made:
Made use of CDP's AgentKit for it's ability to call transactions through NLP chat. Made use of Onchainkit from coinbase as well to integrate UI components with our chat from ElizaOS and AgenKit.
Onchainkit helped in ready made UI components and wallet management through their SDK and Agenkit to integrate transaction functionalities with ElizaOS.
